description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Nofollow, which adds rel="nofollow" to outbound links in HTML content if the Attr.Nofollow configuration is enabled. The class transforms HTML attributes to ensure outbound links are marked appropriately for SEO and security considerations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Nofollow
classes.description: Class responsible for adding rel="nofollow" attribute to outbound links during HTML attribute transformation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method, initializes the URI parser instance.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the given HTML attributes by adding rel="nofollow" to outbound links based on URL scheme and locality.
